opportunities.title: Visiting research fellowships

amount.raw: UK – up to £600; Europe – up to £700; Rest of world – up to £1,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to academics or curators working on historic and contemporary sculpture (Institute fellowships) and researchers whose interests lie in Henry Moore (Studios & Gardens fellowships). Artist Research Fellowships are also available for artists to develop practice through research. Senior Fellowships for established scholars.
opportunities.summary: Each year the fellowship programme enables artists and researchers to develop their work, offering a month of access to facilities in Leeds or Hertfordshire, with accommodation, travel and subsistence expenses.
